column1: # rule_provenance_note: A rule of the circulated paper.
# formula: Sort N descending, then 0.15A + 0.05U + 0.05R + 0.05Q + 0.05E + 0.05L descending, then school name ascending

# normalization_anchors: secondary_participation (A): observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=54.95, p95=233.05; valid 24 of 25 | activity_scale (A): log1p of the value floored at 0, then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=6.908754779315, p95=6.908754779315; valid 24 of 25 | conflict_exposure (A): log1p then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=0, p95=0.262364264467; valid 24 of 25 | urgency (U): observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=0.005, p95=0.695; valid 23 of 25 | reach (R): log1p then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=5.363875711563, p95=7.368709180792; valid 24 of 25 | aqi (Q): observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=29, p95=146; valid 21 of 25 | emissions (E): log1p then observed 5th/95th percentile scaling; p05=0, p95=7.573803102331; valid 22 of 25 | land (L): natural 0..1 fraction; natural 0..1 fraction; valid 23 of 25
# tie_rule: exact numeric score descending, then school name ascending in Unicode code point order
# sort_keys: sort_key_primary, score_point descending, then source_school_name ascending
# filters_effect: Filters only hide rows. Ranks, bounds and anchors are those of the full run.

# display_name: display_name is source_school_name with an apostrophe in front when the name starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return, so that a spreadsheet application does not read it as a formula. source_school_name is always exact: use it to join and to rebuild the list.
# k_meaning: k cuts the rule's full list: point rows have rank_point <= k, and range rows have a best possible rank (rank_best) <= k. Filters then hide rows; they never renumber a rank.

# range_school_convention: Range schools are interval schools: an environmental input is missing, so they have a score range and a rank range and no point rank or point score. They appear in their own rows (row_kind=range), after the point rows, ordered by best possible rank. They are not placed in the point order. The JSON list places them at their lower-score position by default, and at their upper-score position only when placement=upper is asked for as a labelled sensitivity.

# how_to_rebuild: Keep rows with row_kind=point. Sort by sort_key_primary, score_point descending, then source_school_name ascending in Unicode code point order. The result lists the rows in rank_point order.

# caveat: Research prototype for screening. The list orders existing school records for closer inspection. It does not establish condition accuracy, site safety, intervention benefit or an optimal investment portfolio. A missing input is unknown, not zero. Normalized AQI, reported greenhouse-gas emissions and modal land-cover classes are different contextual measures, and together they are not a validated health or hazard scale. Ranks have different scopes: read each with its scope label. Urgency enters this rule; how its source value was extracted and what it means are unresolved.
